subject: Deployment readiness & MAP: capacity commitments and GPU sizing
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@orionhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP ask — Dedicated/Private lead times + GPU sizing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership asked for a Mutual Action Plan that clearly calls out: Dedicated vs Private lead times (procurement cadence), a realistic close timeline, and recommended GPU pool sizing for an initial pilot and production ramp. They want the MAP to include acceptance criteria (performance & security gating), a procurement handoff checklist, and any SOC2 / evidence items that could block a September/October activation.

High-level constraints from our side:
- Pilot scope: 100k inference qps equivalent (mixed chat + embedding workloads)
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence required before private deployment (some flexibility for Dedicated)
- Procurement: billing team needs ~8 weeks for a reserved capacity contract review

Could you produce a MAP spreadsheet with two tranche options (pilot -> production), lead times for Dedicated and Private delivery, and a short list of acceptance tests we can use to sign off? Also please include any assumptions about model selection/quantization that materially change GPU counts.

Attaching: none yet — procurement asked to see a compact checklist first.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Orion Health Systems

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP ask — Dedicated/Private lead times + GPU sizing

Elaine — thanks for the clear constraints. I put together a compact MAP that maps evaluation gates to procurement and capacity handoffs. Attached: Orion_MAP_v3.xlsx (draft). Key notes below:

Summary (draft):
- Tranche A (Pilot): 20 H100-equivalent GPUs (mixed-precision) — goal: validate latency at 2k concurrent chat users and baseline embedding throughput. Lead time: Dedicated pool activation ~4 weeks; Private (VPC appliance) delivery ~10-12 weeks (SOC2 gating likely adds 2–4 weeks after evidence collection).
- Tranche B (Production): incremental add to 180–220 GPUs depending on model quantization. Lead time: Dedicated additional capacity ~2–4 weeks after tranche A (scales within reserved pool); Private production ramp ~8–12 weeks (procurement + install windows).

Assumptions that change GPU counts: model family selection (LlamaX-70B vs OpenC-40B), sequence length (avg 512 vs 1024), and whether you accept int8 quantization for embeddings. I call out three sizing scenarios in the sheet.

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Functional: 95th p99 latency < 350ms for 512-token chat workloads in pilot synthetic traffic; embeddings average throughput > 300/s per GPU node (mixed workload).
- Security: SOC2 evidence folder + audit log export available for private deployments; for Dedicated we can provide per-tenant audit logs and encrypted-at-rest options immediately.
- Ops: Runbook handover and 2-day canary with rollback policy.

Next steps:
1) Review draft MAP and confirm which sizing scenario to baseline.
2) Align procurement timeline (Elaine — can you confirm target DocuSign/PO date?).
3) Book a 60-min walkthrough (I propose Tue 9/7 or Wed 9/8).

I included Karthik for technical sizing and Marissa/Ben for capacity commercial flow. If helpful we can convert this to a mutual action timeline with milestone owners.

Attachment: Orion_MAP_v3.xlsx (draft outline) — spreadsheet contains tranche matrix, lead-time assumptions, acceptance tests, and a minimal procurement checklist.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee

Team — following up with technical sizing and a short ops checklist to include in the MAP before the walk-through. Attaching gpu_sizing_model_matrix.pdf and SOC2_Audit_ask.docx for the packet.

Technical highlights (to include in final MAP):
- Pilot baseline: 20 H100-equivalent GPUs -> expected steady-state embedding throughput ~6k/s and 2k concurrent chat sessions at target latency when using a mix of DDP batching + prefix KV cache.
- Production baseline: 200 GPUs (H100-eq) for LlamaX-70B unquantized; with int8 quantization you can target ~120–140 GPUs for equivalent throughput.
- Fast-fail plan: if latency regression observed during canary, automatic fallback to smaller context model (OpenC-40B) with token-level routing; this reduces GPU pressure while preserving functional availability.

Ops/procurement checklist to drop into MAP:
- Bill-of-materials: SKU list for Dedicated reservation + lead times for burst capacity.
- Evidence bundle: list of SOC2 artifacts we can supply (audit log exports, encryption certs, configuration snapshots).
- Acceptance test harness: scripts + sample dataset reference (will be delivered as a private Drive link).

I'll flag items that change capacity (model family, avg seq length, quantization) so the sales-side spreadsheet can show sensitivity analysis. Marissa/Ben — please review commercial lead times and confirm the minimal committed tranche we can offer for a 30% discount bucket.

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
